subject: general
question: Pilgrimage Tax, which was based on religious discrimination, was abolished by Akbar in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1563__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pilgrimage Tax based on Religious discrimination was abolished by Akbar in the year **1563.**
 
• **Jaziya Tax **is also a Religious tax abolished in the year **1564.**
 
• It is varied according to the urge of the collector of the tax.
 
• All restrictions on the building of places of worship were removed by Akbar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Qutb-ud-din Aibak** established **Jaziya** for the first time. 
 
• **Dahsala** is an Indian land taxation system introduced in A.D. 1580 under the reign of **Mughal Ruler **Akbar.
 
• **Akbar **believed in secularism. 
 
• In **1563 AD Mughal Emperor Akbar abolished the pilgrimage tax** on Hindus.
